question: Encuentra los depósitos (vaults) que contienen contactos con al menos una meta 'activa' que ha tenido streaks registrados y que además tienen parámetros de seguimiento de estado de ánimo (mood tracking parameters) con un color hexadecimal específico, ordenados por el nombre del depósito.

SELECT v.id, v.name, v.description FROM vaults v JOIN contacts c ON v.id = c.vault_id JOIN goals g ON c.id = g.contact_id JOIN streaks s ON g.id = s.goal_id JOIN mood_tracking_parameters mtp ON v.id = mtp.vault_id WHERE g.active = TRUE AND mtp.hex_color = '#FF0000' GROUP BY v.id, v.name, v.description ORDER BY v.name;

SELECT p.* FROM posts p WHERE p.published = TRUE AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_tag pt JOIN tags t ON pt.tag_id = t.id WHERE pt.post_id = p.id AND t.slug = 'marketing-digital') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_post cp JOIN contacts c ON cp.contact_id = c.id JOIN contact_group cg ON c.id = cg.contact_id JOIN groups g ON cg.group_id = g.id WHERE cp.post_id = p.id AND g.name = 'Equipo Creativo') ORDER BY p.written_at DESC;

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.written_at FROM posts p INNER JOIN post_tag p_t ON p.id = p_t.post_id INNER JOIN tags t ON p_t.tag_id = t.id INNER JOIN contact_post c_p ON p.id = c_p.post_id INNER JOIN contacts c ON c_p.contact_id = c.id INNER JOIN contact_group c_g ON c.id = c_g.contact_id INNER JOIN groups gr ON c_g.group_id = gr.id WHERE p.published = 1 AND t.slug = 'marketing-digital' AND gr.name = 'Equipo Creativo' ORDER BY p.written_at DESC;

question: Identifica las empresas que tienen más de diez contactos, donde cada uno de esos contactos tiene al menos una dirección de tipo 'oficina' ubicada en la ciudad de 'Madrid', ordenadas por el nombre de la empresa.

SELECT c.* FROM companies c WHERE (SELECT COUNT(co.id) FROM contacts co JOIN addresses a ON co.id = a.contact_id JOIN address_types at ON a.address_type_id = at.id WHERE co.company_id = c.id AND at.name = 'Oficina' AND a.city = 'Madrid') > 10 ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT comp.id, comp.name FROM companies comp WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cont.id) FROM contacts cont JOIN addresses addr ON cont.id = addr.contact_id JOIN address_types atype ON addr.address_type_id = atype.id WHERE cont.company_id = comp.id AND atype.name = 'Oficina' AND addr.city = 'Madrid') > 10 ORDER BY comp.name;

question: Busca los eventos de vida que involucraron a un participante con un nombre y apellido específicos, que ocurrieron entre dos fechas determinadas y que están asociados a un evento de línea de tiempo (timeline event) que está colapsado dentro de un depósito (vault) con un nombre concreto.

expected_orms: LifeEvent::query()->where('happened_at', '>=', '2023-01-01')->where('happened_at', '<=', '2023-12-31')->whereHas('participants', fn ($q) => $q->whereFirstName('Ana')->whereLastName('García'))->whereHas('timelineEvent', fn ($q) => $q->where('collapsed', true)->whereHas('vault', fn ($v) => $v->where('name', 'Archivos Familiares')))->get()

LifeEvent::whereHas('participants', function ($query) { $query->where('first_name', 'Ana')->where('last_name', 'García'); })->whereHas('timelineEvent', function ($query) { $query->where('collapsed', true)->whereHas('vault', fn ($q) => $q->where('name', 'Archivos Familiares')); })->whereHappenedAtBetween('2023-01-01', '2023-12-31')->get()
expected_sqls: SELECT DISTINCT le.* FROM life_events le JOIN life_event_contact lec ON le.id = lec.life_event_id JOIN contacts c ON lec.contact_id = c.id JOIN timeline_events te ON le.timeline_event_id = te.id JOIN vaults v ON te.vault_id = v.id WHERE c.first_name = 'Ana' AND c.last_name = 'García' AND le.happened_at BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND te.collapsed = 1 AND v.name = 'Archivos Familiares';

SELECT le.* FROM life_events le WHERE le.happened_at BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM life_event_contact lec JOIN contacts c ON lec.contact_id = c.id WHERE lec.life_event_id = le.id AND c.first_name = 'Ana' AND c.last_name = 'García') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM timeline_events te JOIN vaults v ON te.vault_id = v.id WHERE le.timeline_event_id = te.id AND te.collapsed = 1 AND v.name = 'Archivos Familiares');

SELECT le.id, le.label, le.happened_at FROM life_events le JOIN life_event_contact lec ON le.id = lec.life_event_id JOIN contacts cont ON lec.contact_id = cont.id JOIN timeline_events te ON le.timeline_event_id = te.id JOIN vaults va ON te.vault_id = va.id WHERE cont.first_name = 'Ana' AND cont.last_name = 'García' AND le.happened_at >= '2023-01-01' AND le.happened_at <= '2023-12-31' AND te.collapsed = TRUE AND va.name = 'Archivos Familiares';

question: Para cada país, determina cuáles tienen más de cinco direcciones de tipo 'Hogar' registradas en depósitos (vaults) cuyos nombres incluyen la palabra 'personal', mostrando solo el nombre del país y el conteo de estas direcciones.

expected_orms: Address::from('addresses as a')->join('address_types as at', 'a.address_type_id', '=', 'at.id')->join('vaults as v', 'a.vault_id', '=', 'v.id')->where('at.name', 'Hogar')->where('v.name', 'LIKE', '%personal%')->groupBy('a.country')->select('a.country')->selectRaw('COUNT(a.id) as count_addresses')->having('count_addresses', '>', 5)->get()
expected_sqls: SELECT a.country, COUNT(a.id) AS total_addresses_hogar FROM addresses a JOIN address_types at ON a.address_type_id = at.id JOIN vaults v ON a.vault_id = v.id WHERE at.name = 'Hogar' AND v.name LIKE '%personal%' GROUP BY a.country HAVING COUNT(a.id) > 5;

SELECT country, (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM addresses a2 JOIN address_types at2 ON a2.address_type_id = at2.id JOIN vaults v2 ON a2.vault_id = v2.id WHERE a2.country = a.country AND at2.name = 'Hogar' AND v2.name LIKE '%personal%') AS count_addresses FROM addresses a GROUP BY country HAVING count_addresses > 5;

SELECT a.country, COUNT(a.id) AS address_count FROM addresses a JOIN address_types at ON a.address_type_id = at.id JOIN vaults v ON a.vault_id = v.id WHERE at.name = 'Hogar' AND v.name LIKE '%personal%' GROUP BY a.country HAVING COUNT(a.id) > 5;

question: Busca los eventos de línea de tiempo (timeline events) que contienen eventos de vida asociados a la emoción 'Alegría' y que, además, tienen participantes que trabajan en una empresa de tipo 'Financiera'.

expected_sqls: SELECT DISTINCT te.* FROM timeline_events te JOIN life_events le ON te.id = le.timeline_event_id JOIN emotions e ON le.emotion_id = e.id JOIN timeline_event_contact tec ON te.id = tec.timeline_event_id JOIN contacts c ON tec.contact_id = c.id JOIN companies co ON c.company_id = co.id WHERE e.name = 'Alegría' AND co.type = 'Financiera';

SELECT te.* FROM timeline_events te WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM life_events le JOIN emotions e ON le.emotion_id = e.id WHERE le.timeline_event_id = te.id AND e.name = 'Alegría') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM timeline_event_contact tec JOIN contacts c ON tec.contact_id = c.id JOIN companies co ON c.company_id = co.id WHERE tec.timeline_event_id = te.id AND co.type = 'Financiera');

SELECT te.id, te.label FROM timeline_events te INNER JOIN life_events le ON te.id = le.timeline_event_id INNER JOIN emotions em ON le.emotion_id = em.id INNER JOIN timeline_event_contact te_c ON te.id = te_c.timeline_event_id INNER JOIN contacts co ON te_c.contact_id = co.id INNER JOIN companies comp ON co.company_id = comp.id WHERE em.name = 'Alegría' AND comp.type = 'Financiera' GROUP BY te.id, te.label;

question: Obtén los contactos que tienen una fecha importante de tipo 'Cumpleaños' en el mes de 'Julio', y que pertenecen a un depósito (vault) de tipo 'Familia'.

expected_sqls: SELECT DISTINCT c.* FROM contacts c JOIN contact_important_dates cid ON c.id = cid.contact_id JOIN contact_important_date_types cidt ON cid.contact_important_date_type_id = cidt.id JOIN vaults v ON c.vault_id = v.id WHERE cidt.label = 'Cumpleaños' AND cid.month = 7 AND v.type = 'Familia';

SELECT c.* FROM contacts c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_important_dates cid JOIN contact_important_date_types cidt ON cid.contact_important_date_type_id = cidt.id WHERE cid.contact_id = c.id AND cidt.label = 'Cumpleaños' AND cid.month = 7) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vaults v WHERE v.id = c.vault_id AND v.type = 'Familia');

SELECT c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM contacts c INNER JOIN contact_important_dates cid ON c.id = cid.contact_id INNER JOIN contact_important_date_types cidt ON cid.contact_important_date_type_id = cidt.id INNER JOIN vaults v ON c.vault_id = v.id WHERE cidt.label = 'Cumpleaños' AND cid.month = 7 AND v.type = 'Familia' GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name;

question: Encuentra los módulos que están asociados a una página de plantilla (template page) con el slug 'pagina-de-contacto' y que contienen filas (rows) que a su vez tienen campos (fields) que son 'requeridos' y de tipo 'texto_largo'.

expected_sqls: SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM modules m JOIN module_template_page mtp ON m.id = mtp.module_id JOIN template_pages tp ON mtp.template_page_id = tp.id JOIN module_rows mr ON m.id = mr.module_id JOIN module_row_fields mrf ON mr.id = mrf.module_row_id WHERE tp.slug = 'pagina-de-contacto' AND mrf.required = 1 AND mrf.module_field_type = 'texto_largo';

SELECT m.* FROM modules m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM module_template_page mtp JOIN template_pages tp ON mtp.template_page_id = tp.id WHERE mtp.module_id = m.id AND tp.slug = 'pagina-de-contacto') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM module_rows mr JOIN module_row_fields mrf ON mr.id = mrf.module_row_id WHERE mr.module_id = m.id AND mrf.required = 1 AND mrf.module_field_type = 'texto_largo');

SELECT m.id, m.name FROM modules m INNER JOIN module_template_page mtp ON m.id = mtp.module_id INNER JOIN template_pages tp ON mtp.template_page_id = tp.id INNER JOIN module_rows mr ON m.id = mr.module_id INNER JOIN module_row_fields mrf ON mr.id = mrf.module_row_id WHERE tp.slug = 'pagina-de-contacto' AND mrf.required = TRUE AND mrf.module_field_type = 'texto_largo' GROUP BY m.id, m.name;

question: Lista las metas (goals) que han registrado más de diez streaks y que pertenecen a contactos cuya religión es 'Cristianismo'.

expected_sqls: SELECT DISTINCT g.* FROM goals g JOIN streaks s ON g.id = s.goal_id JOIN contacts c ON g.contact_id = c.id JOIN religions r ON c.religion_id = r.id WHERE r.name = 'Cristianismo' GROUP BY g.id HAVING COUNT(s.id) > 10;

SELECT g.* FROM goals g WHERE (SELECT COUNT(s.id) FROM streaks s WHERE s.goal_id = g.id) > 10 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contacts c JOIN religions r ON c.religion_id = r.id WHERE c.id = g.contact_id AND r.name = 'Cristianismo');

SELECT g.id, g.name FROM goals g INNER JOIN streaks s ON g.id = s.goal_id INNER JOIN contacts c ON g.contact_id = c.id INNER JOIN religions r ON c.religion_id = r.id WHERE r.name = 'Cristianismo' GROUP BY g.id, g.name HAVING COUNT(s.id) > 10;

question: Busca los archivos de tipo 'imagen/jpeg' que están almacenados en depósitos (vaults) que contienen, en total, más de cincuenta archivos.

expected_sqls: SELECT f.* FROM files f JOIN vaults v ON f.vault_id = v.id WHERE f.mime_type = 'image/jpeg' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM files f2 WHERE f2.vault_id = v.id) > 50;

SELECT f.* FROM files f JOIN (SELECT vault_id, COUNT(id) AS file_count FROM files GROUP BY vault_id HAVING COUNT(id) > 50) AS v_counts ON f.vault_id = v_counts.vault_id WHERE f.mime_type = 'image/jpeg';

SELECT fil.id, fil.name, fil.mime_type FROM files fil INNER JOIN vaults va ON fil.vault_id = va.id WHERE fil.mime_type = 'image/jpeg' AND (SELECT COUNT(f_sub.id) FROM files f_sub WHERE f_sub.vault_id = va.id) > 50;

question: Identifica los grupos de tipo 'Familia' que incluyen contactos cuyo primer nombre comienza con la letra 'A' y que no han sido marcados como eliminados.

expected_sqls: SELECT DISTINCT g.* FROM groups g JOIN group_types gt ON g.group_type_id = gt.id JOIN contact_group cg ON g.id = cg.group_id JOIN contacts c ON cg.contact_id = c.id WHERE gt.label = 'Familia' AND c.first_name LIKE 'A%' AND c.can_be_deleted = 0;

SELECT g.* FROM groups g WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_types gt WHERE gt.id = g.group_type_id AND gt.label = 'Familia') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_group cg JOIN contacts c ON cg.contact_id = c.id WHERE cg.group_id = g.id AND c.first_name LIKE 'A%' AND c.can_be_deleted = 0);

SELECT gr.id, gr.name FROM groups gr INNER JOIN group_types gt ON gr.group_type_id = gt.id INNER JOIN contact_group cg ON gr.id = cg.group_id INNER JOIN contacts cont ON cg.contact_id = cont.id WHERE gt.label = 'Familia' AND cont.first_name LIKE 'A%' AND cont.can_be_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY gr.id, gr.name;

question: Obtén las plantillas de posts (post templates) que pertenecen a una cuenta con un límite de almacenamiento de 1024 MB y que incluyen secciones de plantilla que no pueden ser eliminadas.

expected_sqls: SELECT DISTINCT pt.* FROM post_templates pt JOIN accounts a ON pt.account_id = a.id JOIN post_template_sections pts ON pt.id = pts.post_template_id WHERE a.storage_limit_in_mb = 1024 AND pts.can_be_deleted = 0;

SELECT pt.* FROM post_templates pt WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts a WHERE a.id = pt.account_id AND a.storage_limit_in_mb = 1024) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM post_template_sections pts WHERE pts.post_template_id = pt.id AND pts.can_be_deleted = 0);

SELECT pt.id, pt.label FROM post_templates pt INNER JOIN accounts acc ON pt.account_id = acc.id INNER JOIN post_template_sections pts ON pt.id = pts.post_template_id WHERE acc.storage_limit_in_mb = 1024 AND pts.can_be_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY pt.id, pt.label;

question: Lista todas las direcciones de correo electrónico de tipo 'Correo Personal' de contactos de género 'Femenino' cuyo primer nombre contenga 'Maria'.

expected_sqls: SELECT DISTINCT ci.data FROM contact_information ci JOIN contact_information_types cit ON ci.type_id = cit.id JOIN contacts c ON ci.contact_id = c.id JOIN genders g ON c.gender_id = g.id WHERE cit.name = 'Correo Personal' AND cit.protocol = 'email' AND g.name = 'Femenino' AND c.first_name LIKE '%Maria%';

SELECT ci.data FROM contact_information ci WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contact_information_types cit WHERE cit.id = ci.type_id AND cit.name = 'Correo Personal' AND cit.protocol = 'email') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contacts c JOIN genders g ON c.gender_id = g.id WHERE c.id = ci.contact_id AND g.name = 'Femenino' AND c.first_name LIKE '%Maria%');

SELECT ci.data FROM contact_information ci INNER JOIN contact_information_types cit ON ci.type_id = cit.id INNER JOIN contacts co ON ci.contact_id = co.id INNER JOIN genders gen ON co.gender_id = gen.id WHERE cit.name = 'Correo Personal' AND cit.protocol = 'email' AND gen.name = 'Femenino' AND co.first_name LIKE '%Maria%' GROUP BY ci.data;
